name: A comeback still showing isn't made again when the turn finishes
judge: Boop is still showing pride at a fix when the turn finishes moments later. It shouldn't redo the whole performance.
reasonable: Proud, happy or relieved at the fix. At the finish, quiet, a plain success, or a small glad word or face. A smaller echo of the pride is fine.
unreasonable: Replaying the same full relief as if the fix had just happened, or turning sad or cross at a good finish.
